correctness.rationale: All 256 length-four codewords fall into exactly 15 equality-pattern orbits under symbol relabeling; the explicit rational dual bound is at most one for every orbit and totals \(37/2\) on the 64 received triples. Exact checker replays all incidence, orbit and rational assertions.
